items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Haymen and Hollaway--Hollaway stayed in Texas; didn't he? Did he get fired from the band or what? [INTERVIEWEE] I don't remember how he went out.

ctx.x: By the time we got to St. Louis Hayes Pillars was in the band.
Haymen and Hollaway--Hollaway stayed in Texas; didn't he? Did he get fired from the band or what?
I don't remember how he went out.
